scientific_question: Can the complementary continuous v226 raw block-PRESS and v227 geometry-studentized PRESS signals be combined by one target-rig-identity-blind nested calibration rule that meets the unchanged safety, complete-rig utility, physical-accuracy, and exact-call gates on already opened BLASTNet Cases 5 and 2?
role: results-before for v229 score deserialization, but explicitly post-open development because Cases 5 and 2 and the v226/v227/v228 failure identities were already known when this single calibration formula was chosen

conditions.name: blastnet_case5
conditions.role: already opened nested leave-one-rig-out calibration and development condition

conditions.name: blastnet_case2
conditions.role: already opened cross-condition safety diagnostic; never enters calibration

observable_calibration.score_direction: lower is safer for both parents
observable_calibration.order_statistic: stable sort, zero-based index ceil(0.1*n)-1; equality accepts
observable_calibration.parent_threshold: For each score separately, take the maximum across fit rigs of that rig's fixed lower-tail order statistic.
observable_calibration.inner_normalized_envelope: For each inner held-out fit rig k, divide each parent score by its threshold calibrated on all other fit rigs and take the pointwise minimum of the two ratios.
observable_calibration.envelope_multiplier: Take the maximum across inner held-out fit rigs of that rig's fixed 10-percent order statistic of the normalized envelope.
observable_calibration.target_rule: Using parent thresholds and multiplier fitted without the target rig, accept direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 exactly when min(raw/tau_raw, studentized/tau_studentized) <= multiplier; otherwise use zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16.
observable_calibration.case5_outer_calibration: For each target Case5 rig, all other 12 Case5 rigs are the fit set; the target rig's scores and identity do not enter its thresholds or multiplier.
observable_calibration.case2_calibration: All 13 Case5 rigs form the fit set; no Case2 score, rig identity, metric, or truth enters thresholds or multiplier.

truth_visible_adjudication.safe_definition: Direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes every frozen absolute per-cell gate and every ratio to zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 is at most 1.05.

independent_validation.formal_inputs: sealed formal v226/v227 continuous score arrays
independent_validation.second_inputs: separately sealed independent v226/v227 continuous score arrays
independent_validation.second_implementation: manual stable sorting and explicit nested rig loops; it may not import the formal v229 helper or runner

decision_order: invalid parent seal, index alignment, positive threshold, observable-before-truth barrier, noninterference, parent drift, or independent mismatch -> INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_NESTED_DUAL_PRESS_CALIBRATION_V229
primary fails Case2 safety, any Case5/Case2 per-rig utility, complete physical accuracy, or per-rig exact-call reduction -> FAIL_NESTED_DUAL_PRESS_CALIBRATION_V229
interpretation_if_primary_passes: The already opened Cases 5 and 2 support a target-rig-identity-blind fold-local calibration mechanism for the two complementary observable scores. Because the formula was chosen after v228, this remains post-open development evidence and only authorizes a separately frozen unopened-condition gate.
